question: Why does Shankara agree to reveal this mantra to the beloved?
premises: Shankara declares he will tell the mantra.
Affection is stated as the motive.
The mantra is described as the essence of all.
inference: Out of affection, Shankara will reveal this mantra, the essence of all, to the beloved.
plain_english: Out of affection I will tell you this mantra, the essence of all, O beloved.
